say:0:1323201001:0.text: Crystalfin, my Fish King, my treasure. I won't let you get away ever again...
say:0:1323201001:0.source_cn: 雾凇影，我的鱼王，我的宝贝，这次一定不会让你跑了……

say:1:1323201002:0.text: Hey, you over there! Why are you just standing there?
say:1:1323201002:0.male: Hey, you over there! Why are you just standing there?
say:1:1323201002:0.female: Hey, you over there! Why are you just standing there?

say:1:1323202001:1.text: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?
say:1:1323202001:1.male: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?
say:1:1323202001:1.female: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?

choice_prompt:2:1323202001.text: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?
choice_prompt:2:1323202001.source_cn: <male>小子</male><female>姑娘</female>！哎，说的就是你，怎么到了河边还干愣着呢！
choice_prompt:2:1323202001.male: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?
choice_prompt:2:1323202001.female: You! Yeah, you! Why are you just staring at the river?

say:3:1323202002:1.text: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?
say:3:1323202002:1.source_cn: 赶紧收拾呀！架起你的鱼竿，撑起你的……等等，你不是来钓...
say:3:1323202002:1.male: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?
say:3:1323202002:1.female: Hurry up and get ready! Set up your rod, and... wait a second. You're not here for the crystalfin, are you?

say:6:1323202005:1.text: You don't know what the crystalfin is?! It's the legend of Cedartown, the myth of the Duchy of Whiteridge, the dream catch of every fisherman!
say:6:1323202005:1.source_cn: 雾凇影你都不知道？！那可是雪松镇的传说，白山公国的神话...

say:7:1323202006:1.text: So the crystalfin is a fish from Whiteridge?
say:7:1323202006:1.source_cn: 所以雾凇影是白山的一条鱼？

say:8:1323202007:0.text: It's not just any fish! It's the Fish King!
say:8:1323202007:0.source_cn: 它可不是一般的鱼！它是鱼王！

say:9:1323202008:1.text: It's the most elusive shadow under the ice... When the first light of dawn breaks and frost forms on the treetops—that's when it frolics beneath the ice.
say:9:1323202008:1.source_cn: 那可是冰下最神秘的身影……每当晨曦初现，太阳刚露头那会...

say:10:1323202009:1.text: Countless seasoned fishermen have camped on the ice at dawn, only to leave empty-handed amid the morning mist. They say catching it is harder than finding a fisherman who doesn't brag at the tavern.
say:10:1323202009:1.source_cn: 多少老钓手为了它，大清早就在冰面上扎营，结果只能跟着晨...

say:11:1323202010:1.text: I've been waiting here for ages to try my luck. See, my tent's still over there!
say:11:1323202010:1.source_cn: 我可是在这里蹲守了好久，就为了钓到它——你瞧，我的帐篷...

say:12:1323202011:1.text: You stayed out here all night? This area is dangerous...
say:12:1323202011:1.source_cn: 你直接在这里过夜吗？这附近很危险啊……

say:13:1323202012:1.text: You don't understand. This place is remote, and the crystalfin likes the quiet. The fewer people around, the better your chances.
say:13:1323202012:1.source_cn: 这你就不懂了吧？这地方偏，雾凇影喜静，没人的地方更容易钓到。

say:14:1323202013:1.text: A dedicated fisherman if I've ever seen one...

say:15:1323202014:1.text: He's so full of hope for catching the crystalfin...
say:15:1323202014:1.source_cn: 他对钓雾凇影充满了憧憬呢……

say:16:1323202015:1.text: Exactly! Everyone in the fishing community knows the crystalfin. If I could catch it, I'd release every fish I've ever caught. It'd be worth it!
say:16:1323202015:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛，整个钓圈没有人不知道雾凇影。要是能钓到它，让...

choice_prompt:17:1323202015.text: Exactly! Everyone in the fishing community knows the crystalfin. If I could catch it, I'd release every fish I've ever caught. It'd be worth it!
choice_prompt:17:1323202015.source_cn: 可不是嘛，整个钓圈没有人不知道雾凇影。要是能钓到它，让我把这辈子钓到的所有鱼都放生也值！

say:18:1323202016:0.text: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!
say:18:1323202016:0.source_cn: 钓鱼钓的是种意境！是种感觉……数量并不重要。
say:18:1323202016:0.male: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!
say:18:1323202016:0.female: Don't be so shallow! Fishing isn't about numbers. It's about the experience... the feeling!

say:20:1323202018:1.text: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?
say:20:1323202018:1.source_cn: 满满也有点好奇神秘的鱼王了。主人，不如我们留下来看看吧。
say:20:1323202018:1.male: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?
say:20:1323202018:1.female: Chippy's getting curious about this mysterious Fish King. Magister, why don't we stay and watch?

say:21:1323202019:1.text: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.
say:21:1323202019:1.source_cn: 你想留下来见证我钓上雾凇影？这个嘛，也不是不行……正巧...
say:21:1323202019:1.male: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.
say:21:1323202019:1.female: You want to stay and watch me catch the crystalfin? Well, I don't mind... but I'm out of bait, and I could use someone's help gathering the materials.

say:22:1323202020:0.text: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.
say:22:1323202020:0.source_cn: 这种大鱼只有用最烈的鱼饵才能钓上来，我需要一些烈酒和肉...
say:22:1323202020:0.male: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.
say:22:1323202020:0.female: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.

choice_prompt:23:1323202020.text: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.
choice_prompt:23:1323202020.source_cn: 这种大鱼只有用最烈的鱼饵才能钓上来，我需要一些烈酒和肉糜来做鱼饵。
choice_prompt:23:1323202020.male: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.
choice_prompt:23:1323202020.female: A big fish like this only bites the strongest bait. I need some strong liquor and minced meat to make that kind of bait.

say:24:1323202021:3.text: You don't get it. Fish love the smell of liquor. They get tipsy, lose their sense of direction, and then they're easier to catch. It's my secret trick.
say:24:1323202021:3.source_cn: 这你就不懂了吧，鱼也喜欢这酒香，吃一口醉得不知方向才好...
say:24:1323202021:3.male: You don't get it. Fish love the smell of liquor. They get tipsy, lose their sense of direction, and then they're easier to catch. It's my secret trick.
say:24:1323202021:3.female: You don't get it. Fish love the smell of liquor. They get tipsy, lose their sense of direction, and then they're easier to catch. It's my secret trick.

say:25:1323202022:1.text: For the liquor, head to the <style="highlight">restaurant in Cedartown</style> and buy <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style>. Only the strongest and coldest brew is worthy of the crystalfin!
say:25:1323202022:1.male: For the liquor, head to the <style="highlight">restaurant in Cedartown</style> and buy <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style>. Only the strongest and coldest brew is worthy of the crystalfin!
say:25:1323202022:1.female: For the liquor, head to the <style="highlight">restaurant in Cedartown</style> and buy <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style>. Only the strongest and coldest brew is worthy of the crystalfin!

say:26:1323202023:0.text: For the minced meat, you can get it from my place in <style="highlight">Cedartown</style>. My wife, Tatiana, should be home, and the lights should be on.
say:26:1323202023:0.source_cn: 肉糜呢，你就直接上我家拿吧。我家就在<style=hi...
say:26:1323202023:0.male: For the minced meat, you can get it from my place in <style="highlight">Cedartown</style>. My wife, Tatiana, should be home, and the lights should be on.
say:26:1323202023:0.female: For the minced meat, you can get it from my place in <style="highlight">Cedartown</style>. My wife, Tatiana, should be home, and the lights should be on.

say:27:1323202024:0.text: Just make sure you ask her for my special <style="highlight">frosty meat</style>. Not the regular, cheap bait!
say:27:1323202024:0.source_cn: 记住，一定要叫她拿来我特制的<style=highli...
say:27:1323202024:0.male: Just make sure you ask her for my special <style="highlight">frosty meat</style>. Not the regular, cheap bait!
say:27:1323202024:0.female: Just make sure you ask her for my special <style="highlight">frosty meat</style>. Not the regular, cheap bait!

choice:23:0:1.text: You just want to drink, don't you?
choice:23:0:1.male: You just want to drink, don't you?
choice:23:0:1.female: You just want to drink, don't you?

choice:17:0:1.text: How many fish have you caught?
choice:17:0:1.male: How many fish have you caught?
choice:17:0:1.female: How many fish have you caught?

choice:2:0:1.text: So what should I be doing instead?
choice:2:0:1.male: So what should I be doing instead?
choice:2:0:1.female: So what should I be doing instead?

say:29:1323202003:1.text: What are you talking about? Wait, are you not here to catch the crystalfin?
say:29:1323202003:1.source_cn: 喝什么水呀你真是……等等，你不是来钓雾凇影的？
say:29:1323202003:1.male: What are you talking about? Wait, are you not here to catch the crystalfin?
say:29:1323202003:1.female: What are you talking about? Wait, are you not here to catch the crystalfin?

say:1:1323203001:1.text: Welcome! What can I get you?
say:1:1323203001:1.source_cn: 欢迎光临！几位吃点什么？

choice_prompt:2:1323203001.text: Welcome! What can I get you?
choice_prompt:2:1323203001.source_cn: 欢迎光临！几位吃点什么？

say:3:1323203004:1.source_cn: 我想我知道你说的是谁了。

say:4:1323203005:1.text: You mean this one, right? Winter's Kiss.
say:4:1323203005:1.source_cn: 你要的是这瓶吧，寒冬之吻。
say:4:1323203005:1.male: You mean this one, right? Winter's Kiss.
say:4:1323203005:1.female: You mean this one, right? Winter's Kiss.

say:6:1323203006:1.text: Wow, you guessed it right away!
say:6:1323203006:1.source_cn: 老板娘居然一下就猜到了！好厉害！

say:7:1323203007:1.text: Of course, I remember every customer who comes through our doors.
say:7:1323203007:1.source_cn: 当然，来过餐馆的每一位顾客我都有印象。

say:8:1323203008:1.text: Sergey often buys Winter's Kiss from me. Says it's for fishing. He's the first person I know to give liquor to fish.
say:8:1323203008:1.source_cn: 那个谢尔盖，常来我这里买寒冬之吻，据他所说是为了钓鱼，...

say:9:1323203009:1.text: I bet those fish thought it was some gift from nature, and now they can't find the same taste anywhere else in Whiteridge... that is, until Sergey brings more liquor back again.
say:9:1323203009:1.source_cn: 那些鱼估计还以为是大自然的馈赠呢，然后找遍白山的所有河...

say:10:1323203010:1.text: Here, take both bottles to him. Don't worry about payment. I'll put it on his tab.
say:10:1323203010:1.source_cn: 这两瓶都给他带去吧，不用替他付钱，我会亲自划在他的账上。

choice:2:0:1.text: I need liquor for a fisherman.
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 我来替一个钓鱼佬买酒
choice:2:0:1.male: I need liquor for a fisherman.
choice:2:0:1.female: I'm here to buy some liquor for a fisherman.

say:12:1323203002:1.text: What thing? Hey, don't get any ideas! I don't sell anything illegal here!
say:12:1323203002:1.source_cn: 那个是哪个？诶……我这里可不卖违禁品啊！
say:12:1323203002:1.male: What thing? Hey, don't get any ideas! I don't sell anything illegal here!
say:12:1323203002:1.female: What thing? Hey, don't get any ideas! I don't sell anything illegal here!

say:13:1323203003:1.text: No, no, we're just here to buy some liquor for fishing!
say:13:1323203003:1.source_cn: 不是不是，我们是来帮人买一瓶钓鱼用的酒的！

choice:2:1:2.text: Do you have... you know, that thing?
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 你有没有那个……就是那个……
choice:2:1:2.male: Do you have... you know, that thing?
choice:2:1:2.female: Do you have... you know, that thing?

say:1:1323204001:0.text: Not many people come looking for me. I'm guessing Sergey sent you.
say:1:1323204001:0.source_cn: 很少有人会来找我，我猜你们是从谢尔盖那儿来的。

say:2:1323204002:0.text: Tell me, did he sneak off somewhere remote to fish and finally get eaten by the undead?
say:2:1323204002:0.source_cn: 说吧，是不是他偷偷去什么荒无人烟的地方钓鱼，终于被活死...

say:5:1323204005:1.text: OWW! That hurt! Don't do that again! What if you knock something loose?!
say:5:1323204005:1.source_cn: 哎哟！满满又说错话了，不要敲满满的头嘛！

say:6:1323204006:0.text: We're here on your husband's behalf to pick up his frosty meat.
say:6:1323204006:0.source_cn: 我们受您丈夫所托，来取他钓鱼用的寒霜腌肉。

say:7:1323204007:0.text: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.
say:7:1323204007:0.male: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.
say:7:1323204007:0.female: Ah, alright. I'll get some for you.

say:8:1323204008:0.text: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!
say:8:1323204008:0.source_cn: 就这几块了，叫他省着点用吧，不好好打猎就知道钓鱼，家里...
say:8:1323204008:0.male: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!
say:8:1323204008:0.female: This is all we have. Tell him to use it sparingly. Instead of hunting properly, all he does is fish. Now we barely have enough meat at home. And he feeds what little we have to fish!

say:10:1323204009:0.text: Judging by his reaction when asked about his catches, maybe he IS feeding fish instead of catching them...
say:10:1323204009:0.source_cn: 想起问到渔获数量时那个人的反应，说是喂鱼可能也没错……

choice_prompt:11:1323204009.text: Judging by his reaction when asked about his catches, maybe he IS feeding fish instead of catching them...
choice_prompt:11:1323204009.source_cn: 想起问到渔获数量时那个人的反应，说是喂鱼可能也没错……

say:12:1323204010:0.text: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.
say:12:1323204010:0.source_cn: 他哪儿是啊，他就是个打猎的，打猎来腌制好的肉家里都不够...
say:12:1323204010:0.male: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.
say:12:1323204010:0.female: Not by miles. He's a hunter. He cures meat from his hunts, but we barely have enough to eat these days because he keeps using it for fishing.

say:13:1323204012:0.text: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.
say:13:1323204012:0.source_cn: 说钓鱼吧，技术也不行，一天到晚都钓不回来一只，光看他喂鱼了。
say:13:1323204012:0.male: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.
say:13:1323204012:0.female: And he's not even good at fishing! He never brings any fish home. It's more like he's just feeding them.

say:14:1323204013:0.text: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.
say:14:1323204013:0.source_cn: 估计现在鱼一见了他啊，都觉着是女神的使者来馈赠它们了。
say:14:1323204013:0.male: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.
say:14:1323204013:0.female: I bet the fish see him as a messenger of Dura, here to provide them with gifts.

say:16:1323204011:0.text: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!
say:16:1323204011:0.source_cn: 可不是嘛，他是个猎人，打猎来腌制好的肉家里都不够吃，还...
say:16:1323204011:0.male: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!
say:16:1323204011:0.female: Exactly! He's a hunter, but instead of bringing home food, he's wasting all the meat on fish!

say:0:1323205001:0.text: He calls himself a hunter, but he's off fishing again.
say:0:1323205001:0.source_cn: 说是打猎，结果又去钓鱼了

say:1:1323205002:0.text: I'll give him a proper lesson when he comes back!

say:0:1323206001:0.text: We've got everything we need. Time to take it back to Sergey!
say:0:1323206001:0.source_cn: 材料都齐全了，可以回去交给那位谢尔盖了！
say:0:1323206001:0.male: We've got everything we need. Time to take it back to Sergey!
say:0:1323206001:0.female: We've got everything we need. Time to take it back to Sergey!

say:0:1323207001:0.text: You're back! Great, come on over!
say:0:1323207001:0.male: You're back! Great, come on over!
say:0:1323207001:0.female: You're back! Great, come on over!

say:1:1323207002:0.text: I'm tied up here. Could you help me make the bait?
say:1:1323207002:0.source_cn: 我这手腾不开，就麻烦你帮我制作鱼饵了！
say:1:1323207002:0.male: I'm tied up here. Could you help me make the bait?
say:1:1323207002:0.female: I'm tied up here. Could you help me make the bait?

document:0:166:0.text: Pour <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over your cured meat. Add just enough to let that aroma soak in. Next, slice the <style="highlight">frosty meat</style> into thin strips—the texture is key! Once sliced, drizzle another layer of <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over the top and let it all meld together.
document:0:166:0.source_cn: 先将<style="highlight">寒冬之吻</style>浇上腌肉，少量多次，对腌肉进行充分的按摩，使其吸收酒香。再将<style="highlight">寒霜腌肉</style>切做细条，最后再次浇淋一遍<style="highlight">寒冬之吻</style>。
document:0:166:0.male: Pour <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over your cured meat. Add just enough to let that aroma soak in. Next, slice the <style="highlight">frosty meat</style> into thin strips—the texture is key! Once sliced, drizzle another layer of <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over the top and let it all meld together.
document:0:166:0.female: Pour <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over your cured meat. Add just enough to let that aroma soak in. Next, slice the <style="highlight">frosty meat</style> into thin strips—the texture is key! Once sliced, drizzle another layer of <style="highlight">Winter's Kiss</style> over the top and let it all meld together.

say:1:1323208001:0.text: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!
say:1:1323208001:0.source_cn: 嗯……这熟悉的酒香，完美的鱼饵！太感谢你了！
say:1:1323208001:0.male: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!
say:1:1323208001:0.female: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!

choice_prompt:3:1323208001.text: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!
choice_prompt:3:1323208001.source_cn: 嗯……这熟悉的酒香，完美的鱼饵！太感谢你了！
choice_prompt:3:1323208001.male: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!
choice_prompt:3:1323208001.female: Mmm... that familiar scent of liquor. The perfect bait! Thank you so much!

say:4:1323208002:0.text: Still, I appreciate you running the errand for me.
say:4:1323208002:0.source_cn: 那也得感谢你帮我跑这一趟。
say:4:1323208002:0.male: Still, I appreciate you running the errand for me.
say:4:1323208002:0.female: Still, I appreciate you running the errand for me.

say:5:1323208004:0.text: Rest easy. Tomorrow morning, you'll be witnessing the legend of the Fish King!
say:5:1323208004:0.source_cn: 把心放肚子里吧，明天一早就让你见证鱼王的传奇！
say:5:1323208004:0.male: Rest easy. Tomorrow morning, you'll be witnessing the legend of the Fish King!
say:5:1323208004:0.female: Rest easy. Tomorrow morning, you'll be witnessing the legend of the Fish King!

say:6:1323208005:1.text: But for now, we'll need some patience. Let's secure the tent. This is where we'll be holed up for the rest of the night.
say:6:1323208005:1.source_cn: 不过现在还需要一些耐心，先来把帐篷加固一下吧，我们后半...
say:6:1323208005:1.male: But for now, we'll need some patience. Let's secure the tent. This is where we'll be holed up for the rest of the night.
say:6:1323208005:1.female: But for now, we'll need some patience. Let's secure the tent. This is where we'll be holed up for the rest of the night.

say:7:1323208006:1.text: The late-night wind on this ice can be brutal. If the tent gets blown away, never mind catching the Fish King—you'll be too sick to do anything for three days.
say:7:1323208006:1.source_cn: 后半夜这冰面上的冷风可不是一般人遭得住的，要是帐篷被掀...
